question: Should OpenClaw add a native context-pressure alert/recovery contract for subagent and child sessions, and what threshold, parent identity, operator notification target, and recovery behavior should it support?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior adds policy and possibly config surface across diagnostics, subagent lineage, operator alerts, and recovery routing, which automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add narrow health signal
options.body: Add a bounded context-pressure diagnostic/notification path using existing session lineage and contextBudgetStatus, with recovery kept explicit or operator-approved.

options.title: Defer to manual status tooling
options.body: Keep current /status, /context, sessions.list, and external monitoring behavior without a native parent escalation contract.

options.title: Design broader orchestration policy
options.body: Treat this as part of a larger agent hierarchy/recovery framework and defer implementation until that product direction is intentionally sponsored.

recommendation.title: Add narrow health signal
recommendation.body: Add a bounded context-pressure diagnostic/notification path using existing session lineage and contextBudgetStatus, with recovery kept explicit or operator-approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The current checkout routes both the session-row projection and diagnostic heartbeat surface through line ranges blamed to Peter Steinberger, and the decision spans core session/diagnostic policy.
